note: Mecklenburg County VA publishes its zoning map only as a JPG image (meck44.com) and its GIS portal (meck.southsidegis.org, a legacy viewer) exposes redistricting layers, not zoning districts, and no ArcGIS REST zoning service was found. The county's adopted zoning map is a Felt map with no official queryable source. Towns: Clarksville's zoning map is a PDF (2019); Boydton and Chase City have no GIS zoning found. ArcGIS Online searches turned up only NC Mecklenburg County layers or personal parcel-derived copies.
